title: Cops Took Her Kids and She Made Things WAY Worse
description:
A custody dispute between a woman and her kids' two fathers erupted after the concerned parents called Wisconsin police asking for their kids to be returned. Alicia A. Orzel, who was enjoying a day on the lake with her kids, was having none of it. When deputies eventually secured the children, Orzel turned the small dispute into something much more. Watch the incident unfold on bodycam footage from Sawyer County deputies.
